theme_and_vibe.description: Paper-textured, black/ivory/red samurai art direction. Brutalist, raw, ink-wash aesthetics. ZERO gradients, ZERO glassmorphism, NO soft shadows, and NO decorative effects without functional purpose. Energetic, aggressive, but grounded in traditional Japanese printing palettes.
theme_and_vibe.age_gate: 18+ marking is prominent due to lockly leaderboards/wagering content.

headings.description: Tall, tightly-tracked sans-serif used for massive hero layers and raw creator energy. All caps. Fallback: Bebas Neue.
headings.usage: H1, H2, massive background text layers in the hero section.

body_and_data.description: Clean, highly legible monospace font for data, leaderboards, technical details, and points.
body_and_data.usage: Tables, numbers, points, stream games stats.

fallbacks.description: Used ONLY for long-form legal text (Privacy Policy, Terms, Giveaway Rules, Responsible Gambling Notice).

primary.name: Cinnabar Red
primary.usage: CTAs, active states, key highlights, 18+ warnings, and aggressive borders.

background_dark.name: Ink Black
background_dark.usage: Base background for the application, ensuring high contrast with text.

background_light.name: Washi Ivory
background_light.usage: Foreground cards, modals, tables. Acts as the 'paper' texture base.

borders.name: Harsh Black
borders.usage: Thick 2px to 4px borders around ALL interactive elements.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use an SVG noise filter or subtle CSS pattern overlaid on #e8e4d9 to simulate rough Washi paper. Do NOT use heavy images that impact performance.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Strictly solid block shadows (e.g. shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#da291c]). Zero blur radius allowed.
visual_enhancers.borders: Square edges ONLY (rounded-none). Heavy borders to create a comic-book / block-print feel.

layouts.hero: Layered typography composition. Background: Oversized 'GreekGodBerry' text -> Middle: /assets/greek-cutout.png -> Foreground: Overlapping typography -> Floating: Social links behind the cutout. Aggressive asymmetry.
layouts.cards: Neo-brutalist grids. Thick borders, solid background colors, high density data (for leaderboards), and strict rectangular geometry.
layouts.navigation: Solid background (no transparency/glass). Stark white/ivory or ink black background with high contrast links.

components.splash_screen: Real asset-loading splash with 0-100 progress counter. Timeout/error fallback logic required. Must use /assets/splash.webp. Repeat-visit skip using localStorage. Reduced-motion treatment required.
components.cursor: Desktop paw cursor activated ONLY on precise-pointer devices (media query: @media (pointer: fine)) with a click animation. Touch/reduced-motion modes MUST use the native cursor.
components.leaderboard: Lockly Leaderboard with a podium (top 3) + dense brutalist table for the rest. Privacy-masked anonymous players (e.g., 'Anon***').
components.store: Card grid for stocked rewards. Red/Ivory brutalist cards. Points redemption mechanics.
components.stream_games: Interactive modules for quiz/prediction/raffle using site points.

washi_texture.description: White textured paper surface (used as a lightweight background texture layer if CSS noise isn't enough).

store_placeholder.description: Red gift card (used as a placeholder for store items).

accessibility_and_performance.motion: Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion'. Provide static fallbacks for video/effects (use /assets/samurai-coin.png as fallback for the greenscreen mp4). Disable paw cursor click animations if reduced motion is enabled.
accessibility_and_performance.focus: Visible, highly contrasted focus states (e.g., ring-4 ring-red outline).
accessibility_and_performance.controls: Semantic HTML controls only. Keyboard navigability is strictly required for the Store and Leaderboard tables.
accessibility_and_performance.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cutout', data-testid='login-button').
accessibility_and_performance.performance: Target behavior for a basic $200 phone. Avoid heavy JS layout shifts. Rely on CSS over JS where possible.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the brutalist, samurai aesthetic. Do NOT use default shadcn rounded corners, soft shadows, or muted grays.
Implement the splash screen with a 0-100 counter using a React useEffect hook to simulate asset loading, and store a flag in localStorage to skip on repeat visits.
Build the hero section using CSS z-index layering to place social links and text both in front and behind /assets/greek-cutout.png.
The paw cursor must be applied to the body or main container using a CSS class that is activated conditionally via a hook checking window.matchMedia('(pointer: fine)').
Leaderboard must have a podium for top 3 and a dense table. Use IBM Plex Mono for all numbers/scores.
Add 18+ age gate modal or persistent banner, along with clear affiliate/sponsor disclosure and responsible-gambling notices.
For the Store and Admin console, use flat, brutalist cards and data tables. Do not use generic neon cards or glassmorphism anywhere.
For .js files, ensure React components are written using clean functional paradigms, semantic HTML, and Tailwind classes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use AI assistant emojis. Every interactive element requires a heavy, brutalist hover state (e.g., solid drop shadow expanding or shifting). Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards, especially red-on-black. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for any overlays, headers, or dropdowns. Prioritize optical alignment over geometric perfection in asymmetrical layouts.
